decision: Do not add MQTT structural-violation features to V1 and do not train a V2 MQTT-structure model from this corpus. After port-gating to plaintext MQTT :1883, MQTT_Malformed_Data shows essentially no structural INVALID signal vs benign.

evidence.attempt1_bug: Parsed all TCP payloads; HTTP/TLS-like bytes falsely became INVALID MQTT and contaminated benign baselines.
evidence.wildcard_topics: mqtt_publish_wildcard_topic_count is zero on malformed and benign — no on-wire PUBLISH wildcard evidence in FIT.
evidence.incomplete_after_gate: INCOMPLETE rates collapse to ~0 after the port gate; segmentation was not the dominant issue once false MQTT detection was removed.

recommended_next: Document MQTT_Malformed_Data as a detection limitation of the current pipeline + captures, or pursue non-structural approaches only with new evidence. Do not deepen CONNECT validation for this corpus based on v2m1b.
